'''Litten Smitten''' (Japanese: '''ニャビー大好きっ子''' ''{{tt|Nyabby|Litten}} Superfan''), in Japanese also known as '''ニャビ子''' ''Nyabiko'' for short, is the username of a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[HZ093|Clash of the Nidothing Fans]]''. She is one of many fans of [[Dot|Nidothing]]. Her true name is unknown.

==History==
[[File:Nidothing doll.png|250px|left|thumb|Litten Smitten and the Nidothing doll she herself made]]
During a livestream, Nidothing asked her viewers to post about any sightings of rare Pokémon they may have had. After receiving a comment from someone claiming to have seen the [[Black Rayquaza]], Dot sent [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] to [[Teacup Town]] to investigate. There, they met Litten Smitten, who mistakenly assumed they were part of Nidothing's staff team.

Upon learning that Liko and Roy were members of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], Litten Smitten worried that their association with Nidothing would put the latter's reputation at risk. She challenged Liko to a battle with the condition that if Liko lost, she and Roy would have to stop being friends with Nidothing. Both {{pkmn|Trainer}}s proved to be easily matched, but the battle was interrupted by [[Ult]] who came running in chased by an angry mob of {{p|Dodrio}} and {{p|Fearow}}. Using their Pokémon's [[move]]s, Liko and Roy managed to calm the Pokémon down.

Realizing that the rumors about the Rising Volt Tacklers being bad people weren't true, Litten Smitten apologized for her actions and admitted that she impulsively lied about seeing the Black Rayquaza because she wanted to meet Nidothing in person. Nidothing accepted this apology and assured Litten Smitten that she treasures all of her supporters equally. As Liko and Roy left, Litten Smitten promised to spread the word about the Rising Volt Tacklers being good people.

She reappeared during a flashback in ''[[HZ094|The Pokémon Center Lady]]''.

Litten Smitten briefly appeared again in ''[[HZ103|Nidothing Love!]]'', waiting in line for the Nidothing handshake event.

Litten Smitten reappeared in [[HZ136]], being featured as a guest on one of [[Stunner Fisk]]'s livestreams. Once [[Spinel]]'s ambitions were crushed, she and Stunner warned the general public about the dangers of [[Strong Sphere]]s and advocated for the Rising Volt Tacklers's innocence.
